c39752698.notes: Hanging board under a small thatched roof, hostel/café in Kakabona west of Honiara; the 'O' is drawn as a brush circle. Panoramic, so the sign is small in the frame. A parked car's number plate is visible but incidental.

c39852445.notes: Map-and-information board in a narrow panorama. Only the headings are transcribed; the small paragraph text (walking tracks, rubbish bins, toilet, swimming pool, BBQ area, guided tours, venue hire, phone/email) and map labels (ROVE PRISON, LENGAKIKI, TASAHE, Walks legend) are too small to transcribe reliably.

c39852446.notes: Painted yellow panel on an angled white wall, Rove, Honiara; seen obliquely. Small sponsor lines below ('Proudly Sponsored by: Island Manufacturing Ltd, Rotary Club of Honiara, ... Bankers Association, British High Commission, Islands Road Works') are partly cut off and not transcribed. Scribbled graffiti on the panel.

c39852453.notes: Same sign style as c39852446 but a different park. The 'P' of PARK has fallen off, leaving only a small fragment, so the sign visibly reads 'MEMORIAL ARK'. The third line is cut by the bottom frame edge ('Co...' = Committee). A yellow 'APRIL YOUTH MARKET 21ST - 24TH' flyer on the wall is a distractor.

c52800305.notes: Office fascia over a doorway on Honiara's main street, with the national coat of arms at left; 'Solicitors Office' in red script. 'PHone' is mixed-case on the sign.
